artifactType: Sanitized selected-field live query export; not a raw EVTX image or complete terminal transcript
transport: SSH Manager MCP, configured server obipc
command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$s=[datetime]'2026-09-24T12:11:43Z';$e=[datetime]'2026-09-27T12:11:43Z';try{$ts=@(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager/Operational';Id=21,25;StartTime=$s;EndTime=$e} -ErrorAction Stop)}catch{if($_.FullyQualifiedErrorId -like 'NoMatchingEventsFound*'){$ts=@()}else{throw}};$old=Get-WinEvent -LogName Security -Oldest -MaxEvents 1;$new=Get-WinEvent -LogName Security -MaxEvents 1;$a=auditpol /get /subcategory:'Logon'|Out-String;if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'audit query failed'};$b=auditpol /get /subcategory:'Other Logon/Logoff Events'|Out-String;if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'audit query failed'};[pscustomobject]@{HostName=$env:COMPUTERNAME;CollectedUtc=[datetime]::UtcNow.ToString('o');OldestSecurityEventUtc=$old.TimeCreated.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o');NewestSecurityEventUtc=$new.TimeCreated.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o');OldestRecordId=$old.RecordId;NewestRecordId=$new.RecordId;TerminalSessionEventCount=$ts.Count;ConsoleUser=(Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem).UserName;LastBootUtc=(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).LastBootUpTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o');AuditLogon=$a;AuditOtherLogon=$b}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress

projection.AuditLogon:
System audit policy

Category/Subcategory                      Setting
Logon/Logoff
  Logon                                   Success and Failure
